question.text: Pragati Cat II AIF: Total Commitment INR 400 crore. Management Fee 1.5% p.a. (excl. GST @ 18%), charged on TOTAL COMMITTED CAPITAL in Year 1 and on GNAV from Year 2. GNAV end of Year 2 = INR 500 crore. Compute the Year 2 management fee INCLUDING GST.

answer.text: INR 7.50 crore plus INR 0.90 crore GST = INR 8.40 crore

explanation.text: The Logic: Year 2 base = GNAV = INR 500 crore. Fee = 1.5% x INR 500 cr = INR 7.50 crore. GST @ 18% = INR 1.35 crore. Total = INR 8.85 crore. The Trap: A is Year 1 fee on committed capital of INR 400 cr grossed-up (INR 6 x 1.18); C omits GST; D mis-calculates GST at 12%. Cross-Exam Context: Chapter 6 Example 6.2 pattern. XIX-C tests same. Cat III (XIX-E) applies fee on daily NAV — not relevant here. Manager's Pro-Tip: Watch for scenarios where GNAV FALLS below committed capital (e.g., write-downs). Some PPMs lock the base at max(commitment, GNAV) to protect GP; others at min() to protect LP. Negotiate at LPA stage — this is material.
